options.name: public_tabm_direct_v1

options.formula: N=0.5*(retained callsign pool+mean(public physical TabM seeds42,1042,2042)); T=(daily main184+public airport pool+public full174 CatBoost)/3; ordinary=0.71*N+0.29*T; Rome probability=0.5*(public Rome CatBoost three-seed mean+retained R20); apply original final_frame correction rules; nonnegative nearest-integer serialization.
